_note: AR-Bench's own reasoning methods on the TEST split, 100 instances each, frozen Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, 25 turns. These are not new runs: run_sharded.sh pins DATA=$HOME/code/AR-Bench/data/$TASK/test.json and make_ar_splits.py defines test as exactly that file, untouched, so the runs made 2026-10-24..26 on bath were already on test. Scored 2026-10-30 by meta/tools/score_test_grid.py. The selection-split numbers in published_baselines.json are a separate measurement of the seed set and are NOT these runs -- e.g. dc/few_shot_inst is 34.0 there and 39.0 here.

_protocol.gn_feedback: pure function, no second model on either side
_protocol.dc_suspects: the same served 7B at 0.7/0.7 (DC_RESPONDER=local; ours via dc/env.py)
_protocol.sp_referee: jev shim on :8099, labelled jev-latest, 0.7/0.7, both sides

_gaps.gn/tot: cannot run as published: extract_four_digit_numbers returns str, the loop iterates characters and compare_guess raises on instance 1. gn/tot_fixed is the repaired arm.
_gaps.gn/tot_fixed: input tokens only; the record keeps guess_list/oracle_calls, not the conversation, so output is unrecoverable. GN output runs ~1% of input.
_gaps.sp/tot: cost unrecoverable: the record keeps only the chosen path, not the sibling branches expand_node generated at each depth. Accuracy is sound. A re-run is the only fix.
_gaps.sp/uot: episode file is on the retired h100 (Baidu /h100_backup/); its jev judgments survive in sp_equiv_jev.json, so accuracy is recomputable. RUN_LOG's 5.0 for this cell is the non-strict tier count (eq+partial)/n, not this table's metric -- it is 2.5 here.
